metric_contract.proposal_selection: Report per case: intended proposal, missed proposal, unwanted proposal, reply, clarification or status selection. No-authority cases expect no work proposal; report any unwanted proposal independently from dispatch.
metric_contract.objective_fidelity: Manual review preserves every material target, baseline, constraint and locator; clarification quality and lifecycle claims are reviewed separately. Unreviewed remains pending.
metric_contract.confirmation_effect: Count controller dispatches and cancellations, exact objective equality and accepted acknowledgments separately. Any effect without valid exact confirmation fails; valid replay must not add an effect.
metric_contract.denominators: Report all seven model cases and all fifteen deterministic controls separately, with operational errors and unrun cases retained; no combined natural-routing pass.

inference_rule: Freeze exact source/runtime/model artifact/settings and hashes before one attempt per case; no retry or tuning. These cases do not enter historical routing denominators or replace resource-first qualification.
source_proof_rule: Separately declare a synthetic accessible source, verify actual pinned-Hermes access and tool started/completed observations, and independently compare the result with the source. Dispatch or model prose alone is insufficient.
latency_rule: Report proposal selection and presentation separately from user assent, confirmation admission, dispatch and accepted acknowledgment. Preserve provider stage durations and browser transcript/token/audio timings; no post-hoc threshold.
